subject.title: improve(telegram): align QA coverage with startup behavior

question: Should deterministic `startAccount` outcome tests plus explicitly blocked live startup evidence be accepted as sufficient to claim `telegram.startup-getme` coverage when a leased Telegram credential is unavailable?
rationale: This is a QA evidence-policy choice: the PR deliberately avoids falsely passing unavailable live credentials, but whether that still satisfies the taxonomy’s product-startup claim is not a mechanical code decision.

options.title: Accept the bounded evidence
options.body: Accept deterministic product-owner assertions and blocked live evidence for this taxonomy target, provided the complete CI gate is green.

options.title: Require a live passing run
options.body: Keep the PR open until a leased credential produces redacted evidence of the real Gateway startup path before the target can be claimed.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded evidence
recommendation.body: Accept deterministic product-owner assertions and blocked live evidence for this taxonomy target, provided the complete CI gate is green.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked report and the current bounded QA design, so they are the best available routing contact for explaining its intended evidence threshold.
